query:
SELECT COUNT(*) as total, 
       SUM(CASE WHEN entry_type = 'article' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as articles,
       SUM(CASE WHEN entry_type = 'online' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as online_sources
FROM bibliography_entries;
